review: Beautiful ethnic collection for festive season! The embroidery work is stunning and intricate.
Waited 20 minutes just to get into a trial room. Only two fitting rooms for the entire store!
Great designs, but why no sizes above XL? Please stock XXL and 3XL plus size options!
High quality pure cotton kurtis. Very breathable for summer.
Sales staff was very polite and helped me pick the right saree for my sister's wedding.
Prices are on the higher side, but the craftsmanship justifies it.
Trial rooms were dusty and lighting was poor. Hard to see the real color of garments.
The Kanjeevaram silk saree collection is majestic! The zari border quality is 100% authentic pure silk.
Waited 25 minutes for billing counter on Saturday evening. You definitely need two POS billing machines.
Requested custom blouse stitching along with my lehenga, but they do not offer tailoring services. Please add in-house alteration!
Loved the pastel organza dupattas. Very chic for modern bridesmaid looks.
Sales staff in the saree section kept rushing us. Very poor customer hospitality despite high prices.
Do you have plus size lehengas? Hard to find trendy 2XL and 3XL festive options in store.
Handloom cotton shirts for men are so breathable for South Indian summers. Highly satisfied.
Colors on the block print anarkali faded noticeably after just one hand wash. Disappointing dye durability.
The bridal stylist assisted with custom jewelry matching. Exemplary personal shopping service!
Please launch an online WhatsApp catalog so regular customers can reserve festive collections before they sell out.
Chanderi silk festive kurtas under 3000 rupees have fantastic value. Great price to quality ratio.
Parking outside the boutique is a nightmare during peak festive weekends. Valet support is urgently needed.
The Banarasi georgette dupatta collection is breathtaking. Pure artistry in weaving.
Exchange policy is overly rigid. Refused size swap within 48 hours with receipt intact. Need friendlier return policy.
Would love to see kid's ethnic festive wear so whole family can coordinate outfits for Diwali.
Staff helped drape 6 different sarees patiently without showing any frustration. Outstanding patience.
Air conditioning in the upper bridal floor was barely working. Felt very warm during a 1-hour lehenga trial.
Fabric quality of the linen trousers and kurtis is top tier. Elegant minimalist cuts.
Prices on festive silks jumped 20% compared to last year without any noticeable upgrade in fabric weight.
Got my wedding reception sherwani tailored here. Fits like a glove with crisp shoulder padding.
Billing system crashed while paying via UPI. Stood at the checkout for 15 minutes waiting for reboot.
Do you have express 24-hour blouse stitching for emergency wedding invites?
The vegetable dye indigo print collection didn't bleed color at all. Superb colorfastness.
Sales associate pushed higher price band sarees instead of showing what we originally asked for.
Love the sustainable organic khadi cotton section. Modern cuts with traditional handlooms.
Need clear price tags on all rack items. Having to ask staff for every single kurta price is tedious.
Packaging was premium with cloth garment bags and cedar moth repellents. Luxurious touch.

Flawless mirror work on the Navratri chaniya choli. Received so many compliments!
Return refund took 10 business days to reflect in my bank account. Online payment gateway needs faster refunds.
The raw silk jackets for winter wedding receptions are warm, regal, and impeccably tailored.
Found a loose hem thread on the dupatta upon unboxing at home. Quality check before bagging needs attention.
Exclusive hand painted Kalamkari sarees are pure art pieces. Worth every rupee.
